# Box Text vertical alignment — independent native controls

`native_controls.aep` was independently authored in Adobe After Effects 26.5x89
through managed `Client.run_jsx`, not generated by the converter or derived from a
private project. It contains only three public minimal ArialMT Box Text owners.

- AEP SHA-256: `c642695f0c0ff524c1f586ad89c8c84aee716a044687dcc8256e789bef56f854`
- Bytes: 122101
- Managed script SHA-256: `3af1fe441fe58a18e2fdb3dae5d994d1396fe7e5c6ebc0aaf6a86936d8a32f6b`
- Authoring request: `w09-p009-box-vertical-author-v1`, 2026-10-04.
- Composition: native ID 1, `W09 P009 Box Vertical Alignment`, 1280x720,
  square pixels, 30fps, full duration 1 second.
- Layers in native order: `Box BOTTOM`, `Box CENTER`, `Box TOP`.
- All owners: `Vertical alignment`, ArialMT 48, manual leading 52,
  left justification, 360x400 box at [-180,-200], white fill, no stroke.

The authoring script saves/reopens the original controls, reads their exact
identity and numeric values, then changes CENTER to BOTTOM **without saving that
edit into this fixture**. The reopened API ordinals were TOP 12812, CENTER 12813,
BOTTOM 12814. CENTER's measured `sourceRectAtTime(0.5,false).top` changed from
-43.1756591796875 to 113.590637207031 after the edit. Native cleanup and fresh
READY verification succeeded.

The saved COS field `/0/8/0[0]/0/2/13` is absent for TOP, integer 1 for CENTER,
and integer 2 for BOTTOM. Comparing all three native Source Text blobs found this
single differing semantic field; other differences were derived glyph/line-cache
coordinates. Do not serialize the JavaScript API ordinals into this COS field.

Targeted executable assertion:
`export_document::tests::pr4442_text_cases::box_vertical_alignment_matches_independent_native_controls_and_input_edits`.
The test compares a fresh FX export against these native field values. Own-parser
inspection is supplementary; it is not native acceptance of converter output.

**Proof status:** independent native authoring, save/reopen control readback and
numeric native edit response completed. The source-based export regression was
semantic RED (queue2068) and GREEN (2103/2132), with no ignored regression.
